units.source_text: 源氏公子写一封信给老夫人，说道：“只因父皇盼待已久，今日即拟入宫参谒。

en.t: Prince Genji wrote a letter to the old lady, saying, "Because my father the Emperor has been waiting for me for so long, I intend to enter the palace today to pay my respects.

units.source_text: 虽是暂别，但念此次惨遭巨厄，微命仍得苟延至今，便觉心乱如麻，不胜悲切。

en.t: Though this is only a brief parting, when I think how I suffered such a terrible disaster and yet my frail life has dragged on until now, my heart feels tangled in confusion, and I am overcome with grief.

units.source_text: 本当前来面辞，因恐反添烦恼，故暂不求见。”

en.t: I ought to have come to bid you farewell in person, but fearing that this would only add to your distress, I will not seek an audience for the time being."

units.source_text: 老夫人流泪过多，两眼昏花，展读来书，字迹难辨，只是悲恸，不能作书答复。

en.t: The old lady had shed so many tears that both her eyes were blurred; when she opened and read the letter, she could hardly make out the writing, and in her grief she was unable to write a reply.
